I am a Member of Technical Staff at the Centre for AI Research and Excellence (CAIRE) at **[Statistics Canada](https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/start)**.
I build AI systems for federal teams, with a focus on evaluating large language models.

I also work on safety and security, and develop guidance for secure on-premises deployment in settings that handle confidential data.

As a member of the Office of Responsible AI, I lead technical reviews of AI systems across government and contribute to frameworks and governance guidance for **[UNECE](https://unece.org/statistics)**, **[G7 GovAI](https://impact.canada.ca/en/challenges/g7-govAI)**, and the **[International Statistical Institute (ISI)](https://www.isi-web.org/)**.

- First author of a [paper on governing LLM services that handle confidential data](https://doi.org/10.1177/0282423X261489965), published in *Journal of Official Statistics*.
- Won first place in the [2025 IAOS Young Statisticians Prize](https://iaos-isi.org/ysp/) for [LLM-assisted record linkage](https://doi.org/10.1177/18747655261422068), published in *Statistical Journal of the IAOS*.
- Contributed to the development of a **[United Nations](https://unece.org/statistics)** handbook, [*Uncertainty Quantification in ML-Enhanced Statistical Inference*](https://unece.org/sites/default/files/2026-06/Uncertainty%20Quantification%20in%20ML-Enhanced%20Statistical%20Inference.pdf#page=3).

- [Master of Science in Mathematics and Statistics](https://catalogue.uottawa.ca/en/graduate/master-science-mathematics-statistics-concentration-statistics/) at the University of Ottawa
  - Research topic: [Deep Reinforcement Learning and Function Optimization](website_docs/master-thesis-deep-reinforcement-learning.pdf){.accent-link}

## Projects

- I built [Probability Lab](https://www.probability-lab.com/), an interactive probability and statistics platform currently in use at the University of Ottawa's second-year engineering program.
- I published a 6-part series of reinforcement learning labs (Jupyter notebooks): [Reinforcement Learning Labs](rl-labs/).
